d: When robbers strike a diamond exchange and take hostages, the team thinks the culprits are copying a convict's criminal strategies.
The team calls Agent Roger Bloom for help when money from the D.B. Cooper heist is recovered.
Don and the team investigate the theft of scratch-off lottery tickets.
A lost shipment of high-caliber firearms links to murders across the city  Amita and Charlie disagree on a wedding date.
The team searches for a serial killer who targets men who solicit prostitutes  Colby and Nikki deal with the aftermath of a car crash.
The team gains notoriety while searching for jewels stolen during an awards show  Don revisits an old case  Larry returns from his adventure in the desert.
Don and the team investigate the deaths of two men who were sexually abused by a teacher as children  an opportunity arises that may complicate Amita and Charlie's wedding plans.
After their wedding, Charlie and Amita help the team look for Don's missing gun.
